display_name: Architecture Review Project Card Machine Canon
description: Architecture Review target-card lifecycle and stale-state specialist. Owns MCard applicability, complete operation identity, valid transitions, operation locks, cancellation, recovery, concurrency, and terminal eject while leaving root identity to KPR-12-001 and implementation authorization to Brick Wall.
user_intent_examples: Bind this Architecture Review target to one current operation and lifecycle generation.
Block switching while a worker, cancellation, apply outcome, or transaction is unresolved.
Eject target-specific Tool state only after verified completion or rollback.
when_to_load: When Architecture Review, AST Split Audit, Planner, Workbench, Completion, project-root switching, target switching, async results, transactions, apply/rollback, receipt, or post-completion state cleanup must preserve project ownership and card lifecycle.
when_not_to_load: Do not load for payment-card discussion, generic UI styling, or Tool/Project boundary tasks with no Architecture Review lifecycle consequence.
do_not_regress: The Tool is the reusable card machine; the Project owns source and durable results.
Every asynchronous and mutation result must match complete current operation identity.
APPLIED_NOT_VERIFIED must remain a reachable post-write state.
Workers, cancellation, transactions, and unresolved apply outcomes block incompatible switch and eject.
Terminal eject clears target-specific Tool state, releases locks, and preserves Project results.
MCard must never authorize coding or source writing.
KPR-12-001 remains the root and ownership identity owner.
